sample_unit: synthetic datasets generated from two multiple sclerosis RCTs (n=865 and 1516 patients)

links.outcome: Protection against distance-based membership inference attacks and other privacy metrics in synthetic datasets
links.effect: Membership inference protection was hardest privacy metric to optimize but yielded robust privacy; selected datasets had hidden rates of 85.0% and 93.2%.
links.quote: Protection against membership inference attacks was the hardest privacy metric to optimize, but the technique yielded robust privacy and replication of the primary end points (in 72.5% and 80.8% of the 1080 generated datasets).

unlisted_practices: Generating synthetic patient datasets with a privacy-by-design method to enable open data sharing
Selecting synthetic dataset configurations by jointly optimizing privacy and utility metrics

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of generative AI to create synthetic clinical trial datasets (avatars) while systematically evaluating privacy-preserving parameters against membership inference attacks and fidelity/utility tradeoffs.

primary.practice: privacy-by-design synthetic data generation configurations for privacy protection
